You back up three steps, lower your head, and throw yourself at them like a stone from a sling.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Brawn
Target / range / shape
One creature within 4 squares.
Duration
Immediate; Prone and Dazed use their normal rules.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Once per scene.
Type
Signature
Weak
4 physical damage to the target. You take 3 physical damage and are Prone.
Standard
8 physical damage, and the target is Prone. You take 2 physical damage.
Strong
12 physical damage, and the target is Prone and Dazed 1. You take 1 physical damage and are Dazed 1. If you cannot move at least 2 squares, you cannot use this ability. Resolve collisions normally.

Additional rulings
